help_text_0: This is the help section - here you can find text that should help you figure out the game. Hope it helps c:
help_text_1:
Long before the founding of Equestria, the three pony races lived in enmity. However, unlike the pegasi and unicorns, earth ponies were deprived of magic and the ability to fly.
Under constant pressure from the other two warring races, earth ponies have almost no chance to compete with them.
Only by uniting together under one banner can they fight back.
help_text_3: The town hall is the main building of the camp. The game is saved when you light the campfire, build or upgrade the town hall. Each town hall upgrade unlocks new upgrade levels for other buildings. Starting from level two, the town hall lets you skip the night. To skip the night, walk right up to the town hall after sunset and press the interaction key.
help_text_4: The farm is a building that produces food when there is a worker inside. Each upgrade level increases food production. Food is needed to restore the health of units in the camp.
help_text_5:
The armory is a building that produces bows when there is a worker inside. Each upgrade level increases the bow production speed.
To start making a bow, walk right up to the armory with at least 6 wood and stop. A hint will appear right on the building. After you press the interaction key, the bow production will begin. The player takes the very first bow for themselves.
Every unit that takes a bow becomes a hunter. Hunters can't work on the farm or in the armory, and they can't sleep or hide in houses. However, hunters can still chop down trees. If there are free towers in the camp, a hunter will take one right away.
The player can take free hunters into their squad. Each town hall upgrade level adds one free place in the squad. Hunters in the squad follow the player.
help_text_6: The warehouse is an underground building where the camp's resources are stored. Each warehouse upgrade adds more room for resources. The food in the warehouse is the main target of the pegasi and unicorns.
help_text_7: Houses serve as shelter for earth ponies who aren't busy with any work and aren't hunters. Each house upgrade level adds more free places in the camp.
help_text_8:
Towers and walls protect the camp. Damaged walls must be repaired, which costs wood. Each town hall upgrade level makes the walls stronger.
Each tower upgrade level increases the shooting range of the hunters on the tower.
help_text_9: You need to set up your camp within a few days and survive at least 7 in-game days. To start building the camp, light the campfire in the center. To do this, walk right up to it, stop and press the interaction key.
